execution: Next-session open; fixed stop with adverse gap fills; exit at fifth-session close. No overlapping trades per symbol.
calibration: Frozen cold-start prior with no outcome updates during either episode; state isolated from the live application.
selection: Four predeclared instruments per market spanning broad US equity, technology, finance, energy and Indian large caps. Selected surviving instruments, not a point-in-time universe.
news: Curated summaries of primary-source macro announcements, available only from the next calendar day; trailing 30-day window. Not a complete company-news archive.
model_mode: Actual production quant, FinBERT, grounded arguments, deterministic CRO and final auditor. Gemini not configured and not evaluated. Learned classifier is evaluated separately because production CRO does not consume it.
